questions.question: Which of these countries is completely landlocked?
questions.fun_fact: Bolivia is one of two landlocked countries in South America, alongside Paraguay.

questions.question: What is the atomic number of the element carbon?
questions.fun_fact: Carbon has an atomic number of 6, meaning every carbon atom has 6 protons in its nucleus.

questions.question: What is the fastest land animal in the world?
questions.fun_fact: The cheetah can accelerate from 0 to 60 mph in just a few seconds.

questions.question: In which year did the Titanic sink in the North Atlantic Ocean on its maiden voyage?
questions.fun_fact: The RMS Titanic struck an iceberg on the night of April 14, 1912, and sank hours later.

questions.question: Which animated Disney film features the song 'A Whole New World'?
questions.fun_fact: 'A Whole New World' won the Academy Award for Best Original Song at the 65th Academy Awards.

questions.question: Paneer is a type of fresh cheese commonly used in the cuisine of which country?
questions.fun_fact: Paneer is an unaged, acid-set, non-melting farmer cheese that holds its shape well when cooked.

questions.question: How many players make up a starting team on the field in a standard game of soccer (association football)?
questions.fun_fact: Each of the two teams in a standard soccer match fields up to 11 players at a time, including the goalkeeper.

questions.question: What is the linguistic term for a word that reads the same forwards and backwards, such as 'kayak'?
questions.fun_fact: The word 'palindrome' is derived from Greek roots meaning 'running back again'.

questions.question: Which of Jupiter's Galilean moons is the most volcanically active body in our solar system?
questions.fun_fact: Io's intense volcanic activity is driven by tidal heating caused by its gravitational interactions with Jupiter and other moons.

questions.question: What is the hardest known natural mineral on the Mohs scale of mineral hardness?
questions.fun_fact: Diamond occupies the maximum rating of 10 on the Mohs hardness scale.
